examples: Original guided calculations and inspected game observations, selected practice exercises; not a verbatim reproduction of every textbook exercise

contract.axes: Positive axes are defined by arrows, x cross y = z. y drawing-up, body z forward; screen/anatomical directions do not define handedness.
contract.order: Intrinsic body Y-X-Z; R=Ry(h)Rx(p)Rz(b), equivalent extrinsic fixed Z-X-Y.
contract.bookDifference: Left-handed/row-vector book conventions adapted explicitly; signs and basis must be checked independently of transpose.
contract.units: Narrative examples in degrees; code and rotation vectors explicitly radians.
